units.source_text: 我对登石阶，礼拜之后，从架在香资箱旁的棚架上取下了一个旧六角木盆，拿在手中摇了摇，

en.t: After climbing the stone steps and worshipping, I took an old hexagonal wooden basin from the shelf beside the offering box and shook it in my hands,

units.source_text: 从孔里摇出了一支削得细细的竹签。

en.t: and from the hole I shook out a thinly shaved bamboo slip.

units.source_text: 竹签上用黑墨写了"十四"两个字。

en.t: On the bamboo slip, the two characters "fourteen" were written in black ink.
